title: Elite: The Bargain Opens: Hidden Law
description: The Bargain Opens unfolds across black iron court with volcanic glass aisles and ember chain channels, pushing a one active Infernal Dominion Titan to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Bargain Opens: Hidden Law advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
